max_candidates.note: web/contracts.py MAX_CHOICE=100; manifest packed_max_candidates=19, shortlist triggers at 20 candidates; score is limited to 2-10 ordered labels; systemone to 1-8 questions

selective_automation.defer_behavior: shortlist-route decisions report automation='defer' and defer_reason 'model_deferred'; the decision payload still carries probabilities and confidence
selective_automation.policy_source: artifacts/release/selective_policy.json (operating_epsilon='disabled'; the validation-selected 5% threshold observed 6.99% risk on development-exposed reporting data)

supported.deployment_model: single audited English release bundle loaded via load_release_manifest with full hash verification; target-domain with a validated selective policy required before any automation is enabled
supported.calibration: per-cardinality temperature buckets for packed choice plus a frozen hierarchical route temperature (1.971127355603397), pinned and hash-verified in the release manifest; noul and categorical score use checkpoint temperatures only; ordinal score is research-only

unsupported.multilingual: not validated; the multilingual encoder exists (mmBERT, models/production/multilingual) but has no production evaluation; manifest marks multilingual_choice/noul/score RESEARCH ONLY
unsupported.high_candidate_retrieval: candidate counts above the gateway cap of 100 are not accepted; the K=8 shortlist projection is Banking77-trained and cross-domain retrieval quality is not assumed
unsupported.moderation: no content moderation capability in this release
unsupported.arbitrary_schemas: unseen schemas require target-domain evaluation before production; state is capped at 12 KB and instructions at 500 characters
unsupported.zero_shot_classification: unrestricted zero-shot is not production-scoped; only the four audited primitives are served
unsupported.autonomous_without_deferral: all production decisions require the selective policy with abstention; manifest automation.status is DISABLED
unsupported.phase9_hypothesis_scoring: RESEARCH ONLY; development-exposed lineage and unresolved injection sensitivity, not loaded by the manifest
unsupported.ordinal_score: RESEARCH ONLY (veya/experimental/ordinal.py); served score is categorical only

unsupported_input_behavior.unsupported_language: returns a defer decision with defer_reason 'unsupported_language' (veya/lang.defer_reason rejects non-Latin script and non-English Latin text on the English checkpoint)
unsupported_input_behavior.excess_candidates: returns 400 invalid_input from the gateway ('Choice requires 2-100 candidates'); the model server rejects schema violations with defer_reason 'invalid_schema'
unsupported_input_behavior.missing_policy: fail-closed: load_release_manifest verifies the selective policy artifact by SHA-256 and refuses startup if missing or mismatched
unsupported_input_behavior.hash_mismatch: fail-closed: load_release_manifest recomputes every runtime/config/tokenizer/router/shortlist/calibration/policy hash and raises before serving; the server never becomes ready
